content: The treatise as translated ends with a note that it was completed on 18 Rabīʿ I 829, which Melvin-Koushki converts to 28 January 1426. His footnote says this may alternatively refer to the date on which the treatise was copied.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
